_comment: C-EVAL-1 golden set for retrieval-only threshold calibration. Generic-first: queries phrased as a real operator would ask; relevance judged by expected_sheets membership of retrieved hits (sheet-level relevance is robust and does not hard-code STT/locator). in_scope=true queries SHOULD survive the similarity gate; in_scope=false (out-of-scope) queries SHOULD be refused (NO_EVIDENCE). Extend freely; keep >=8 per class.
